purpose: High-value source candidates not yet admitted to the ATLAS source registry. A backlog entry is not an integration claim.
admissionRule: Move a candidate into sources.json only after exact endpoint, licence/terms, access method, product semantics and a bounded first-use case are verified.

candidates.name: MET Norway Oceanforecast 2.0
candidates.access: REST GeoJSON; public access requires a compliant identifying User-Agent
candidates.value: Wave height/direction, ocean current direction/speed, sea-water temperature and related marine forecast variables for local ocean context and Oslofjord/Norway-adjacent experiences.
candidates.firstUse: Point-query adapter from selected ATLAS ocean coordinates; keep forecast time and model semantics explicit.

candidates.name: MET Norway Oslofjord 0.1
candidates.access: MET Weather API product; exact map/data endpoints to inventory before admission
candidates.value: High-value local current-map context for the Oslofjord flagship journey without inventing a 4PLANET monitoring layer.
candidates.firstUse: Inventory exact available products and choose one bounded current-map proof.

candidates.name: GEBCO Global Bathymetry WMS
candidates.coverage: Global ocean and land elevation context
candidates.licence: Acknowledgement required; exact dataset/version citation must be preserved
candidates.value: Global bathymetric context and a useful comparison/fallback complement to Europe-focused EMODnet Bathymetry.
candidates.firstUse: Probe current GetCapabilities and compare visual/performance/coverage against EMODnet without presenting them as interchangeable products.

candidates.name: Argo Ocean Profiling Floats
candidates.access: Official GDAC NetCDF for authoritative archive; Argo also documents API access through Argovis
candidates.value: In-situ temperature, salinity and profile context that can move ATLAS beyond remote-sensing-only ocean views.
candidates.firstUse: Select one bounded access route and normalize profile identity, time, depth and QC flags before map rendering.

candidates.name: NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP
candidates.coverage: Global and regional datasets depending on product
candidates.access: Public ERDDAP REST/OPeNDAP/WMS for public datasets
candidates.value: One standardized access family for SST, salinity, sea ice, ocean colour and buoy/satellite products; strong source-factory fit.
candidates.firstUse: Inventory allDatasets, rank exact products, admit only one product at a time with dataset-specific units/time/licence.

candidates.name: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0
candidates.coverage: Global at 250 m for mapped soil properties
candidates.access: Public WMS for visualization, WCS for bounded data subsets, WebDAV for full maps
candidates.value: Global soil organic carbon, pH, nitrogen, texture, bulk density and uncertainty layers relevant to land systems, restoration and food.
candidates.firstUse: WMS visual proof for one property plus explicit depth interval and prediction uncertainty; no generic soil-quality score.

candidates.name: ESA WorldCover
candidates.coverage: Global 10 m land cover for available WorldCover releases
candidates.value: High-resolution global land-cover context for forest, agriculture, urban and habitat journeys.
candidates.firstUse: Use a single release as dated land-cover context; never infer change by comparing releases made with different algorithm versions without qualification.

candidates.name: JRC Global Surface Water v1.4
candidates.access: Public dataset; exact non-Earth-Engine serving path for ATLAS must be selected
candidates.value: Surface-water occurrence, seasonality and long-term change for freshwater and land-water relationships.
candidates.firstUse: Find a direct redistribution/tiles/download route suitable for ATLAS; do not call historical change current water state.

candidates.name: Global Biotic Interactions (GloBI)
candidates.coverage: Global interaction records aggregated from cited datasets
candidates.access: Public REST API and versioned integrated datasets
candidates.value: Predator-prey, pollination, parasitism and other biotic interaction records that can strengthen Living Systems without inventing ecological relationships.
candidates.firstUse: One Orca/prey or bee/pollination relationship slice with exact dataset/reference provenance and no universalization from individual interaction records.
